description: Print the harness version at session start; before each prompt, at most every 30 minutes, tell the session when a newer harness exists (and fast-forward a clean skills-dir checkout); after each turn, fast-forward the clone the hooks run from (at most every 10 minutes, only when safe) and file this session's turn ledger in the Library; tell subagents apart in the harness store (before a Bash call that runs harness, or every Bash call under HARNESS_ENFORCE=1, record the call and stamp it with its key, which the harness CLI needs to believe its session or subagent; file each subagent's start in the Library and bind it to its recorded spawn); gate worker spawns and merges on the harness spec (before an Agent call that names an item role, record the spawn in the store or, under HARNESS_ENFORCE=1, deny it; before a merge call, deny it under HARNESS_ENFORCE=1 unless the item's verifier passed the pinned head, and deny a GitHub write the gate cannot read); keep the version and install state in the status line (hooks module status.tsx). All do nothing unless the project has installed the harness.
